# cb:b572

> Every persisted thread carries a routing ledger: a table with one row per topic the thread touches, holding the strand state (open, paused, closed), the dispatch pointer (the focus doc the strand's content routed to, or unrouted), and the dangling question when one is pending. Synthesized content always lands in focus docs, never in the ledger; the ledger carries only pointers and states, so it cannot become a digest of the thread or a shadow copy of the seeds. A multi-topic thread is resumed by reading its ledger, not by replaying the conversation or trusting memory.
